purpose: The independent verification set for #409's frozen shipping definition: every development brief outside the eight client-report-checkpoint briefs, whose 72 artifacts and 96 human verdicts are the calibration set. Paolo has given no ship verdict on any artifact of these briefs, and every artifact run here is new, so none can leak from calibration into verification. The judge has seen these briefs' Phase 0 baseline documents (server 2.0.0 cold, skill 3.2.0 assisted), which belong to neither set. Run once each on a fixed revision with no judge; the sheets are judged, by Paolo and by the frozen definition, only after the definition is frozen.
